name: Unified Civil Number (UCN)
note: Bulgaria's sheet (its government's own sheet on the OECD's automatic-exchange portal ('Information on Tax Identification Numbers'; the OECD's index page sits behind a bot check and wasn't opened, the sheet itself came straight back)), read 2026-10-30: Bulgarian citizens' tax number is the Unified Civil Number, 10 digits, assigned (the sheet says) by the Ministry of Interior and shown on every identity document; foreigners with long-term or permanent residence have a 10-digit Personal Number of a Foreigner and other tax residents an NRA number (not modelled). When it's given (at birth registration, by the civil registry) the sheet doesn't say, so it's read as registration; its check digit isn't described, so `check` is left out. The name and issuer are as the sheet gives them, in English.

sources.title: OECD AEOI portal, Bulgaria: Information on Tax Identification Numbers (the jurisdiction's own sheet)
sources.said: For Bulgarian citizens – Unified Civil Number (UCN) which consists of a block of 10 digits; ... The Unified Civil Number and the Personal Number of a Foreigner are assigned by the Ministry of ... Interior and could be found in all identity documents.
